Pharmacy services at Pacific Fair

Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair offers far more than prescriptions. Here is everything our pharmacists and team can help with at our store on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Broadbeach. Most services don’t need an appointment; just walk in.

Prescriptions and medicines

Prescriptions & eScripts Paper scripts, eScripts, Active Script Lists, hospital, interstate and vet scripts. Send yours ahead. Medication packing (Webster packs) Your medicines sorted by day and time in weekly blister packs. Medication reviews A free one-on-one check of all your medicines with a pharmacist. Health Station checks Free blood pressure, weight, BMI and type 2 diabetes risk checks. Diabetes & NDSS NDSS access point for subsidised diabetes supplies, with pharmacist advice. Weight management support Free, private one-on-one support from our pharmacists. Delivery Health and beauty products delivered across the Gold Coast via Uber Eats. Click & Collect Shop online at priceline.com.au and collect from us, usually within 15 minutes. Priceline Pharmacy app Order scripts ahead, get reminders and manage your Sister Club rewards.

Vaccinations and health

Vaccinations Flu, COVID-19, whooping cough, shingles, RSV, pneumococcal and travel vaccines. Walk in or book. Flu vaccination Yearly flu shot, walk in or book. Free for eligible people under the NIP. Travel health & vaccinations Travel vaccines, a travel health kit and advice on taking your medicines overseas. Contraception consultations Start, change or continue the pill, ring or injection with a trained pharmacist. $35. UTI treatment Assessment and treatment for uncomplicated bladder infections, women 18 to 65. Emergency contraception Available from our pharmacists without an appointment, in private. Women's health Contraception, UTI treatment, pregnancy, periods and menopause support from our pharmacists. Quit smoking Help choosing quit options, making a plan and staying on track.

Beauty and everyday

Passport & visa photos Australian and overseas passport and visa photos while you wait. $25. Ear piercing Hygienic single-use system, earrings and aftercare included. $65, walk in. Skincare & self-tan Free advice from trained beauty advisors, and brands that suit the Gold Coast climate. Makeup & fragrance Makeup, fragrance, dental care and men’s grooming with help from our beauty team. Vitamins & supplements Everyday and practitioner ranges, checked against your medicines by a pharmacist. Metagenics Practitioner-range supplements in stock or ordered in, with pharmacist advice.

Doctors inside our store

Help Medical GPs An independent bulk-billing GP clinic inside our store, with QML pathology collection. Walk-ins welcome.

Other things we can help with

  • Return unwanted medicines. Bring back expired or unwanted medicines for free, safe disposal through the national Return Unwanted Medicines program.
  • Absence-from-work certificates. Our pharmacists can issue certificates for short absences. Ask at the counter.
  • Veterinary prescriptions. We dispense scripts written by your vet. See prescriptions.
  • Rapid antigen tests. We sell rapid antigen tests in store. We no longer offer supervised testing.
  • Gift ideas and gift cards. Ask our beauty team for help choosing a gift. See makeup and fragrance.

Looking for a hearing test or ear wax removal? Simply Hearing is elsewhere in Pacific Fair; ask at our counter for directions.

Book or ask

See how to book each service, call (07) 5592 2099, or simply ask at the counter.

Always read the label and follow the directions for use. This information is general in nature and isn’t a substitute for personal advice from your pharmacist or doctor.

Common questions

Do I need to book?

For most services, no. Vaccinations, health checks, passport photos, ear piercing and pharmacist advice are all walk-in. Contraception consultations need a trained pharmacist, so please call first; UTI consultations are walk-in. See how to book each service.

Is there a doctor in the store?

Yes. Help Medical is an independent general practice located inside our store, with bulk billing for eligible patients and a QML Pathology collection room. Walk-ins are welcome subject to doctor availability; booking ahead is the surest way to be seen.

Do you deliver?

Yes, for everyday health and beauty products, through Uber Eats across the Gold Coast. Prescription medicines can’t be ordered through Uber Eats and we don’t offer a regular prescription delivery service. See delivery options and Click & Collect.

Where are you?

On the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre in Broadbeach, on the north-eastern side next to Proud Smile, near the outdoor entrance from the river. See opening hours and directions.
